test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The area of the sector of a circle of radius 12 cm is 32 π cm² Find the length of the corresponding arc of the sector.
solution:
**Given:**

The area of a sector of a circle = 32 π cm²

Radius of circle (R) = 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of a sector = (π × R² × θ)/360

Lenght of an arc = (2 × π × R × θ)/360

**Calculation:**

Area of a sector = (π × R2 × θ)/360

⇒ 32π = (π × (12)2 × θ)/360

⇒ 32 × 360 = (144 × θ)

⇒ θ = (32 × 360)/144

⇒ θ = 80° 

Lenght of an arc = (2 × π × R × θ)/360

⇒ (2 × π × 12 × 80)/360

⇒ (16/3) × π

**∴ The correct answer is ​​(16)/(3) π cm.**

1b
